title: CommandActions
description: Fine-tune your server however you want
body:
CommandActions is plugin for making your server more player-friendly.

The plan of this plugin is for you to be able to make even the last parts of your server feel smooth and modern.

Right now, this shows by for example removing these quirky long commands:

`/myownshopcreationmenuplugin:shop`

With the 1.0 Tab Version's Tab Controller you can make these get removed (or remove other ones yourself).

That just makes your players's experience on your server way better.


I will add more features frequently, probably every 1-2 weeks.

[wiki (might not be finished)](https://github.com/Ontey6/CommandActions/wiki/Getting-Started)

[ACTUAL LICENSE.](https://github.com/Ontey6/CommandActions/blob/master/LICENSE) The license on modrinth is not valid

# 1.0 Version
Right now, the plugin can only be used to control the tab, but very advanced.

**Remember to enable the listener**

What is meant with tab is the list of commands in chat,
that appear when pressing the `TAB` key.

You can exclude namespaced commands, or make a custom configuration for yourself.
